info.title: SKU.io — Map GL Accounts to the Chart of Accounts
info.description: Map SKU.io's accounting roles (sales, COGS, inventory, AR, AP, sales tax and more) to the customer's QuickBooks Online or Xero accounts, and save only after explicit approval. Use for the Launch Roadmap's "Map GL accounts" step or when journals fail for a missing nominal code mapping.

get.summary: The current mapping: one key per accounting role (sales_orders, cogs, inventory_control, ...), each holding a nominal code id as a string, or null when unmapped.

put.summary: Save mapping keys. Only the keys in the body are written; send nothing but the approved keys. Values are nominal code ids (from list-nominal-codes); an id with no account behind it is refused with 422, per key. Returns the whole mapping. Needs the settings.update permission.

sales_orders.description: Nominal code id for sales income.

shipping_sales_orders.description: Nominal code id for shipping charged to customers.

cogs.description: Nominal code id for cost of goods sold.

inventory_control.description: Nominal code id for the inventory asset (a current asset).

accrued_purchases.description: Nominal code id for purchase clearing (accrued / prepaid purchases).

accounts_receivable.description: Nominal code id for accounts receivable.

accounts_payable.description: Nominal code id for accounts payable.

sales_tax.description: Nominal code id for the sales tax liability.

get.summary: The chart of accounts as SKU.io holds it: { id, code, name, type, archived_at } per nominal code, mirrored from QuickBooks Online or Xero when connected. Archived codes are excluded unless filter[archived]=all.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Page size (default 10). Iterate page until last_page.

schema.description: Page size (default 10). Iterate page until last_page.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: id, name, code or type (prefix - for descending). Default -id.

schema.description: id, name, code or type (prefix - for descending). Default -id.

get.summary: Fallback when the token has no accounting:read — every nominal code as { id, name, code } only (no type), ordered by code. Needs settings:read and the sales_channels.show permission.
